body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Kodingan C Lambat dan Trik Bikin Aplikasi Harian Ngebut". Tulisannya membahas bagaimana konsep partial evaluation dari bahasa c diam-diam menyelamatkan performa aplikasi di ponsel murah harian kita
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "Why Old-School C Optimizations Make Budget Phones Usable". It covers how partial evaluation concepts quietly save daily mobile app performance on budget devices across southeast asia
